qc.environment_note: Pre-run 240 s survey: 0.057 mg jitter, 80% of frames stable, 0 shock events, but -4.5 mg/min zero drift (the dose tares measured -6.2 to -8.7 mg/min) -- the bench was still settling after the auger swap ~25 min earlier. Doses read through drift-fitting brackets; the drift is recorded, not assumed away. Balance re-zeroed before the run.
qc.method_note: blocks="H" only (50 mg x3, 200 mg x3); flow-characterisation blocks A-E and the 1.000 g Block G doses exist for xanthan gum from 2026-08-06 (20260806T140254Z_xanthan-gum). Doses read the balance through balance_filter brackets (config.dose_read_path=bracket), same as the 2026-09-03/04 salt and white-rice-flour Block H runs; the 2026-08-06 Block G doses used read_stable(), so the 1 g point is not the same read method. Column charged to steady state (~143 mg/rev at 90 deg, two pre-flight passes) before the run; lighter fill than 2026-08-06's 186.8 mg/rev.
qc.result_note: 5/6 doses inside +/-5 mg (50 mg: -4.1/-2.3/+59.8-overshoot; 200 mg: +2.5/+2.6/+3.5, the tightest 200 mg triple of the campaign). The overshoot stacks two mechanisms: (1) a +0.1 mg tare residual tipped to-go to 0.0501 g, just past the 0.0500 g bulk-skip threshold, so the CONTINUOUS 55-RPM bulk phase opened on a 50 mg target and landed 20.5 mg before halting -- the same 0.1 mg with the opposite sign skipped bulk on dose 1; (2) the next single 45-deg fine increment delivered +89.6 mg, ~5x the ~18 mg expected at 143 mg/rev -- a slug release from the charged lip. Distinct from salt's +8.9/+13.3 mg increment-granularity overshoots. Intra-dose readings on doses 1 and 5 also swung far beyond drift (-49.9/+56.7 mg between fine cycles; -11.8/+16.4 mg between tap cycles) while white rice flour 95 min earlier on the same balance stepped monotonically at 3-8 mg/cycle -- powder-specific, consistent with triboelectric charging of an organic polymer powder falling into a glass beaker (and with the negative pre-flight tap deltas, -8.8 and -22.7 mg per 10 taps). The 200 mg doses converged cleanly through it because more cycles average the disturbance.

preflight.note: Two 5-rev passes. Pass 1 charged the freshly loaded column (47.9, -8.3, 24.1, 30.1, 99.3 mg/rev); pass 2 reached steady state (62.2, 148.2, 136.8, 154.7, 133.5 mg/rev) -- mg_per_rev is the mean of pass-2 revs 2-5 (143.3), below the 2026-08-06 fully-loaded 186.8 mg/rev at 90 deg, consistent with a lighter fill. Tap deltas were negative on both passes (-8.8, -22.7 mg per 10 taps) with the balance drifting -4.5 mg/min in the pre-run survey; read_stable deltas at this drift are not tap measurements.
